# monotaur_secret (Data Source)

Reads a single Monotaur secret by its ID. Note: the `value` attribute will be empty because the API does not return secret values on read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "monotaur_secret" "webhook_token" {
  id = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the secret to look up.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the secret was created.
- `description` (String) An optional description of the secret.
- `monitor_id` (String) The ID of the monitor this secret belongs to.
- `name` (String) The name of the secret.
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the secret was last updated.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Always empty in the data source because the API does not return secret values on read.
